verdict.rationale: The only sprint-relevant evidence is indirect. Loops can respond to changes in "cycles" (linear-docs-95), which implies Linear has a cycle (sprint) entity. The remaining items are general planning claims: plan from idea to launch, roadmaps, initiatives, and shared skills for running weekly planning. Missing for 10: documentation of creating, scheduling and managing sprints/cycles, backlog-to-sprint planning, sprint progress tracking (burndown/velocity), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sprint workflows.
